🖼️ 界面预览  ·  ✨ 功能全景  ·  🧩 工作原理  ·  🚀 快速安装  ·  🧰 MCP 工具  ·  📂 数据存储  ·  🌌 苍蓝全家桶

> [!IMPORTANT] > **适用范围与原生 Gemini 限制说明** > - **专为外部模型准备**：本插件面向通过 **[苍蓝星轨 (Azure Orbit)](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-orbit)** 等方式挂载到 Antigravity 的**外部推理模型**（如 DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM、MiniMax 等直接透传原生 `reasoning_content` 的模型）。开启后**仅在使用外部模型时自动生效**，使用 Antigravity 原生模型时自动静默跳过，零额外 Token 消耗。 > - **为何无法对原生 Gemini 生效**：Google Cloud Code 服务端不会将 Gemini 的原始内部思考下发给客户端，而是由云端 **Thought Summarizer** 将内部思考压缩改写成客观的英文第三人称摘要返回（并附带本地无法解密的加密 `thoughtSignature`）。因此任何客户端提示词或 Hook 都无法关闭或更改云端摘要器的输出语言。 > - **原生 Gemini 怎么看中文思考**：若希望在原生 Gemini 会话中以中文阅读思考摘要，请使用苍蓝套件中的 **[苍蓝棱镜 (Azure Prism)](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-prism)** 进行按需翻译。 面向 **Google Antigravity** 外部自定义推理模型的零依赖思考语言控制插件。通过 **外接模型智能守卫（`external-model-guard`）+ 生命周期 Hook（默认开启 `PreInvocation` 回合去重强化 + 可选 `SessionStart`）+ 可选静态兜底规则 + MCP Server + Sidecar UI**，让外接推理模型的内部思维链（`thinking / reasoning`）稳定保持简体中文，不强行翻译代码、路径与命令，并支持随时热切换。

💭 外部模型首字起中文思考

专为透传原生 reasoning_content 的外接推理模型设计；涵盖任务分析、工具调用前后推理与报错诊断，严格保留代码与路径原文。

🛡️ 仅外部模型生效 · 原生自动跳过

内置 external-model-guard 守卫，自动识别 custom_models.json 与外接模型标识；原生 Gemini / Antigravity 模型默认静默跳过，零无效注入。

👁️ 自定义文案 & 注入实时预览

支持编写 customText 覆盖内置规则，留空一键还原；面板实时预览每轮 Hook、开场注入与静态兜底的完整文本。

⚡ 热切换感知与回合级去重

支持 per_user_turn / every_invocation 两种粒度，同轮多步工具调用自动去重，中途切换 zh ↔ en 自动通知模型即时更新。


思语中文 · 双档位思考语言控制、注入通道开关与实时预览
简体中文 / 默认英文思考一键热切、静态规则与生命周期 Hook 分项控制、自定义指令编辑及实际注入内容实时预览

### 1. 双档位思考语言预设（即时热切换） - **简体中文思考（默认推荐，`zh`）**： - 要求模型内部思考与推理（涵盖任务分析、方案规划、工具调用前后推理、日志排查、报错诊断与最终自查）从第一个字起全程使用简体中文，禁止先用英文起草再翻译； - 即使提问、代码、报错、路径或工具输出为英文，内部思考仍保持简体中文； - 代码、标识符、文件路径、命令行与报错原文保持原样；最终回复跟随用户最近一条实质提问语言。 - **默认英文思考（`en`）**： - 将内部思考语言交还模型默认英文习惯，仅保留「最终回复跟随用户提问语言」的基础约束。 ### 2. 仅外部模型生效的智能守卫（原生模型零干扰） - **每轮前置强化（`PreInvocation` + `external-model-guard`，默认开启）**： - 自动读取 `~/.gemini/antigravity/custom_models.json` 与外接模型路径特征，**仅在使用外部自定义模型时触发注入**； - 使用 Antigravity 原生模型（含原生 Gemini）时直接静默跳过返回 `{}`，零额外 Token 消耗； - **智能去重与热切换感知**：默认 `per_user_turn`（每轮用户提问注入一次，同轮工具回调自动去重），可选 `every_invocation`，并在对话中途切换 `zh` ↔ `en` 时自动通知模型更新思考语言。 - **新会话开场提醒（`SessionStart` + `external-model-guard`，可选）**：同样仅在识别到外部模型时于会话首步注入一次思考语言锚点。 - **静态全局规则兜底（`rules/AGENTS.md`，默认关闭）**：由于宿主会无差别将静态规则加载给包括原生 Gemini 在内的所有模型，默认保持关闭；仅在确需全模型静态兼容兜底时手动开启。 ### 3. 自定义指令文案与实时预览 - 支持在侧栏面板直接编写自定义思考语言指令（`customText`）覆盖内置文案，留空即可一键恢复官方推荐预设； - 面板底部提供 **「实时注入内容预览」**，清晰展示当前配置下实际写入 `AGENTS.md` 的静态规则与 Hook 前置注入文本。 ### 4. 苍蓝统一视觉与交互体系 - **Sidecar + 独立 Web UI 双形态**：提供直观的右侧栏控制面板，点击顶栏 `Web UI` 可在系统默认浏览器中全屏打开。 - **Neko Glass 毛玻璃界面 & 苍蓝主题色调中心**：支持深色/浅色切换、自定义毛玻璃下拉框（`AzureSelect`）、6 套官方主题预设 + 自定义双色 + 4 个自定义栏位跨插件同步、左侧栏快捷入口开关与 GitHub Release 在线更新检查。 ### 首次使用交互式新手引导（`? 指南`） - **3 步上手教程 + 真实控件定位高亮**：首次打开面板自动弹出分步功能指南，点击「🎯 定位」按钮可在当前界面脉冲高亮对应控件并附带浮动返回条。 - **本机持久化不复弹**：已读状态保存至 `~/.gemini/azure-onboarding.json`（Sidecar 重启换端口不复弹），日后随时可点击顶栏 **`? 指南`** 重看。

```mermaid flowchart LR UI["思语中文 Sidecar / MCP"] -->|"zh ↔ en 热切换"| CFG["~/.gemini/think-zh/config.json"] CFG --> HOOK["默认主通道
PreInvocation / SessionStart"] HOOK -->|"external-model-guard"| DEC{"当前是否为外接自定义模型?"} DEC -->|"是（DeepSeek / Qwen 等）"| INJ["按回合去重注入中文思考提醒"] DEC -->|"否（原生 Gemini 等）"| SKIP["自动静默跳过 · 零额外开销"] CFG -.->|"默认关闭 · 可选兜底"| RULE["静态全局规则
rules/AGENTS.md"] ```

> **前置要求**：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零第三方 npm 运行时依赖，纯 Node.js 原生 ESM 实现）。 ### 方式一 · 一句话让 Antigravity 帮你自动安装（推荐） 直接把下面这句话发给 Antigravity 即可自动完成克隆与核验： > 帮我把 `https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-think-zh.git` 克隆到本机 Antigravity 全局插件目录，目录名设为 `think-zh`，检查目录无误后告诉我，我再按 `Ctrl+R` 重载生效。 ### 方式二 · 命令行手动克隆 ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-think-zh.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\think-zh" # macOS / Linux git clone https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-think-zh.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/think-zh ``` 重启或重载 Antigravity（`Ctrl+R`），在 **Plugins** 管理页确认 **思语中文 · Think-ZH** 已启用即可生效。

| 工具名 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `think_zh_status` | 查看当前思考语言档位（`zh`/`en`）、各通道开关、去重策略、规则文件同步状态及注入预览 | | `think_zh_set` | 修改思考语言档位、静态规则开关、`SessionStart`/`PreInvocation` 开关、触发粒度或自定义指令文案 | | `think_zh_preview` | 不写入磁盘地预览指定参数组合下生成的静态规则与 Hook 注入文本 | | `think_zh_reset` | 一键恢复默认配置并自动同步 `rules/AGENTS.md` | ### 🧪 本地自检 ```bash node --test tests/think-zh.test.mjs ```

点击展开查看本机数据目录与苍蓝套件共享配置路径
- **思考语言配置与会话去重状态**：`~/.gemini/think-zh/config.json`、`state.json` - **苍蓝套件共享主题 / 左侧栏配置**：`~/.gemini/azure-theme.json`、`~/.gemini/azure-sidebar-nav.json`

🌐   简体中文  ·  English

Think-ZH — Chinese Reasoning Switcher · Built for external custom reasoning models: keep internal reasoning in Simplified Chinese from char #1 while automatically skipping native Antigravity / Gemini models

🖼️ Preview  ·  ✨ Features  ·  🧩 Architecture  ·  🚀 Quick Start  ·  🧰 MCP Tools  ·  📂 Storage  ·  🌌 Azure Suite

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Scope & Why Native Gemini Is Not Affected** > - **Built for External Custom Models**: Think-ZH targets external reasoning models mounted into Antigravity (e.g., via **[Azure Orbit](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-orbit)** such as DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, or MiniMax that stream native `reasoning_content`). When enabled, it **only activates on external custom models** and silently skips native Antigravity models with zero extra token overhead. > - **Why It Cannot Work on Native Gemini**: Google Cloud Code does not send Gemini's raw internal thoughts to the client. Instead, Google's server-side **Thought Summarizer** rewrites internal reasoning into an English third-person summary (alongside an encrypted `thoughtSignature` that cannot be decrypted locally). Client-side prompts or hooks cannot disable or change the summarizer's output language. > - **How to Read Native Gemini Thoughts in Chinese**: Use **[Azure Prism](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-prism)** to translate the returned thought summaries on demand. A zero-dependency thinking-language controller for **external custom reasoning models** in **Google Antigravity**. Uses **`external-model-guard` + lifecycle hooks (`PreInvocation` enabled by default with per-turn deduplication + optional `SessionStart`) + optional static fallback + MCP Server + Sidecar UI** to keep external model `thinking / reasoning` in Simplified Chinese without mistranslating code, paths, or error logs, and lets you hot-switch back to default English anytime.

💭 Chinese Reasoning for External Models

Designed for external models streaming native reasoning_content; covers planning, tool reasoning, and debugging while keeping code and raw errors verbatim.

🛡️ External-Model-Only Guard

Built-in external-model-guard detects custom_models.json and external model IDs; native Gemini / Antigravity models are skipped silently with zero overhead.

👁️ Custom Directives & Live Preview

Override built-in directives with customText (clear to restore defaults) and preview exact Hook and optional static fallback payloads live in the panel.

⚡ Hot-Switch Aware & Deduplicated

Choose per_user_turn or every_invocation granularity; mid-session zh ↔ en switches notify the external model automatically on the next turn.


Think-ZH · Thinking Language Switcher, Channel Controls & Live Preview
Instant Chinese/English thinking toggle, granular static/hook channel switches, custom directives & live injection preview

### 1. Dual Thinking-Language Presets (Instant Hot-Switch) - **Simplified Chinese Thinking (Default, `zh`)**: - Directs internal reasoning (task analysis, planning, pre/post tool reasoning, log triage, and final checks) to stay in Simplified Chinese from the very first token; - Keeps Chinese reasoning even when prompts, code, stack traces, or tool outputs are in English; - Preserves code, identifiers, file paths, commands, and raw errors verbatim; final responses match the user's latest prompt language. - **Default English Thinking (`en`)**: - Restores the model's native English reasoning habit while keeping final responses aligned with the user's language. ### 2. External-Model-Only Guard (Zero Interference on Native Models) - **Per-Turn Pre-Injection (`PreInvocation` + `external-model-guard`, enabled by default)**: - Inspects `~/.gemini/antigravity/custom_models.json` and external model path patterns, activating **only when an external custom model is active**; - Silently returns `{}` for native Antigravity / Gemini models with zero extra tokens; - **Smart Deduplication & Hot-Switch Awareness**: Defaults to `per_user_turn` (once per user turn, skipping repeated tool callbacks), optionally `every_invocation`, and detects mid-conversation `zh ↔ en` switches automatically. - **Session Start Hook (`SessionStart` + `external-model-guard`, optional)**: Also guarded to activate only when an external custom model is detected. - **Static Global Fallback (`rules/AGENTS.md`, disabled by default)**: Because Antigravity loads static rules into every session including native Gemini, this channel defaults to off and is kept purely as an opt-in fallback. ### 3. Custom Directives & Live Injection Preview - Write custom thinking-language instructions (`customText`) right inside the panel (leave blank to restore defaults) and inspect the exact live output for both `AGENTS.md` and Hooks. ### 4. Unified Azure Suite UI - **Sidecar + Standalone Web UI**: Clean right-hand control panel plus one-click fullscreen `Web UI` in your browser. - **Neko Glass UI & Shared Theme Center**: Dark/light themes, custom glass dropdowns (`AzureSelect`), 6 official presets + custom dual pickers + 4 shared slots, sidebar toggle, and GitHub Release update checks. ### First-Run Interactive Onboarding (`? Guide`) - **3-Step Walkthrough & Live UI Spotlighting**: Opens automatically on first launch to walk through key features, with one-click spotlight buttons that pulse-highlight the real controls on screen plus a floating return bar. - **Persisted Across Restarts**: Completion state is stored in `~/.gemini/azure-onboarding.json` (survives sidecar port changes), and can be reopened anytime from the topbar **`? Guide`** button.

rules/AGENTS.md"] ```
